overview_description.description:
L. is dedicated to the rebellious notion that women everywhere deserve better. L. strives to bring accountability to the personal care aisle, sourcing certified organic cotton for period products and wipes, as well as natural rubber latex for condoms.

L. is committed to increasing access to personal care products globally through it's solidarity model. That’s why for every L. product sold, one is made accessible to another woman or girl. Today, L. is on track to make over 200 million products accessible to women and girls around the world.

L. is a certified B. Corporation and Y-Combinator graduate. Learn more about our movement at www.thisisL.com
